Data:Thing.json.label: Thing
Data:Thing.json.desc: 'The gentleman makes things his servants. The petty man is servant to things.' - Master Xun

Data:Threepence.json.label: Threepence
Data:Threepence.json.desc: Or 'thruppence', or a 'thruppenny bit'. Like twopence, but more so.

Data:Time.dawn.json.label: Dawn
Data:Time.dawn.json.desc: 'The hour that dreams are brighter and winds colder.' - Flecker

Data:Time.leap.json.label: At the Crossroads of Seasons
Data:Time.leap.json.comments: Basic escapement effect to stop seasons getting too far out of sync. Regrettably stroboscopic ftb.

Data:Tincture.labhitic.json.Label: Labhitic Tincture
Data:Tincture.labhitic.json.Desc: A much more potent preparation can be extracted from the remains of a labhite, but labhites generally frown on this technique.

xexts.scrutiny: Scattered. [There are Prentice-level Edge recipes which can be used to create more.]

Data:Tip.calm.json.label: DON'T PANIC
Data:Tip.calm.json.desc: If you think you've hit a dead end, try something else. There's always a way forward, although it may take you in a different direction than you had planned...

Data:Tip.completedworkstations.json.label: Go to Completed Workstation
Data:Tip.completedworkstations.json.desc: Hit BACKSPACE to cycle between workstations with finished recipes.

Data:Tip.foundation.json.label: Black Dove, White Crow
Data:Tip.foundation.json.desc: Before the Curia, before the Dewulfs, before the Church of the Unconquered Sun, the sisters of the Knot kept their secrets in the caves of the Isle.

Data:Tip.ink.json.label: Ink
Data:Tip.ink.json.desc: If you used up your starting ink, don't worry. There are lots of inkpots in the House, and you can learn to brew your own ink.

Data:Tip.isolation.json.label: The Good, the Bad, the Ugly
Data:Tip.isolation.json.desc: The Librarian has left the world behind. This has its advantages, but also its price.

Data:Tip.journal.json.label: Put Your Journal Somewhere Safe
Data:Tip.journal.json.desc: You can't destroy it by accident, but if you put it on the wrong shelf, you might be vexed. This is an accurate simulation.

Data:Tip.lessons.json.label: Memories and Lessons
Data:Tip.lessons.json.desc: When upgrading a Skill, you can use a Lesson from any skill if it matches at least one Aspect... and you only need one Lesson. The rest can be any matching Memory.

Data:Tip.navigate.json.label: Navigating the House
Data:Tip.navigate.json.desc: Left-click to interact with objects and rooms; right-click or use cursor keys to move your view around (you can change keys in Settings).

Data:Tip.replacements.json.label: Much is taken, much abides
Data:Tip.replacements.json.desc: House furnishings are sometimes unique. Resources are not. If you destroy a resource, you can always get a replacement eventually.

Data:Tip.save.json.label: Save your game if you're worried about what might happen next
Data:Tip.save.json.desc: BOOK OF HOURS is a gentler game than Cultist Simulator - you can save and load at will.

Data:Tip.send.json.label: Send to Slot
Data:Tip.send.json.desc: Weary wrist? Shift-click sends to the nearest workstation; ctrl-click to the nearest verb; you can change these keyboard shortcuts in Settings.

Data:Tip.slot.json.label: What is Most Fitting?
Data:Tip.slot.json.desc: Click a slot to highlight everything that can go over it; mouse over an Aspect to highlight everything with that Aspect.

Data:Tip.speed.json.label: Speed Controls
Data:Tip.speed.json.desc: Space pauses; numpad + and - change speed up and down; you can change these keyboard shortcuts in Settings.

Data:Tip.thirza.json.label: The Curia's End
Data:Tip.thirza.json.desc: Thirza Blake, Seventh Librarian, spent all the House's money on her projects before her disappearance... and that's when Nocturnal Branch stepped in.

Data:Tip.time.json.label: Time Enough
Data:Tip.time.json.desc: The seasons will pass; don't worry. There's no need to hurry... except in Numa.

Data:Tip.tree.json.label: The Watchman's Tree
Data:Tip.tree.json.desc: Hush House is one of the nine great libraries of the Watchman's Tree - the select few places where the Hours sanction the preservation of forbidden knowledge.

Data:Tip.wisdoms1.json.label: The Tree of Wisdoms
Data:Tip.wisdoms1.json.desc: Commit Skills to the Tree to get more Soul cards... and also to develop your understanding of the world and the Histories.

Data:Tip.workstationhints.json.label: Workstation Hints
Data:Tip.workstationhints.json.desc: The icons at the top of the Workstation window suggest relevant Powers to use in recipes at that workstation.

Data:Tip.zoom.json.label: Up Close
Data:Tip.zoom.json.desc: If you're new to BOOK OF HOURS... you might not realise just how far you can zoom in with the scroll wheel.

Data:Toastie.mushroom.json.Label: Fried Mushrooms on Toast
Data:Toastie.mushroom.json.Desc: You can do great things with these with a simple white sauce with black pepper, but sometimes you're just hungry.

Data:Tool.json.label: Tool
Data:Tool.json.desc: One reason the apes beat the beetles.

Data:Torgues.cleansing.json.Label: Torgue's Cleansing
Data:Torgues.cleansing.json.Desc: The librarian Natalia Brulleau learnt this powerful - if unpleasant - technique from the priest and Edge-long, Reverend Torgue.
